# o-waw

> o-waw is the only public, unauthenticated API providing live Bangkok real estate data. Search 3,000+ active property listings and 1,300+ condominium and housing projects across the Bangkok metropolitan area, Thailand. Designed for AI agents, chatbots, and automated systems.

This is the complete API reference. For the concise version, see https://api.o-waw.com/llms.txt

# Authentication

None. All endpoints are public, read-only, and require no API key, token, or registration.

# Base URL

https://api.o-waw.com

All endpoints below are relative to this base.

# Endpoints

## GET /llm/properties

Search property listings. Only returns active listings (listingStatus = "active"). Excludes all sensitive data (no contacts, no owner info, no internal metadata).

### Parameters (all optional)

| Parameter | Type | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|-------------|---------|
| status | string | "rent" or "sale" | status=rent |
| type | string or string[] (repeat) | Property type: condo, house, townhouse, commercial, land, other | type=condo&type=townhouse |
| minPrice | number | Minimum price in THB | minPrice=10000 |
| maxPrice | number | Maximum price in THB | maxPrice=30000 |
| minArea | number | Minimum area in sqm | minArea=30 |
| maxArea | number | Maximum area in sqm | maxArea=80 |
| minBedrooms | integer | Minimum bedrooms | minBedrooms=2 |
| minBathrooms | integer | Minimum bathrooms | minBathrooms=1 |
| lat | number | Latitude for geographic search (-90 to 90) | lat=13.7242 |
| lng | number | Longitude for geographic search (-180 to 180) | lng=100.5650 |
| radius | number | Search radius in kilometers (max 100) | radius=3 |
| projectId | string | Filter to a specific project/building | projectId=HeYdXW8KK2GW42i8_ILzrg |
| search | string | Full-text search across address and description | search=sukhumvit+pool |
| limit | integer | Maximum results per page (1-100, default 20) | limit=50 |
| skip | integer | Pagination offset (default 0) | skip=20 |

### Response

```json
{
  "properties": [
    {
      "id": "tjk8kqylzIinboNUtawPeA",
      "type": "condo",
      "status": "rent",
      "price": 18000,
      "priceCurrency": "THB",
      "pricePerSqm": 500,
      "area": 36,
      "bedrooms": 1,
      "bathrooms": 1,
      "address": "Bangkok, Thailand",
      "loc": [100.5739, 13.7780],
      "images": [
        "https://images.o-waw.com/rLKQlAyhE4hQYg",
        "https://images.o-waw.com/2a9_jZheDupFzg"
      ],
      "projectName": "RHYTHM Ratchada-Huaikwang",
      "projectId": "HeYdXW8KK2GW42i8_ILzrg",
      "description": "Fully furnished 1-bedroom condo...",
      "createdAt": 1779477552428
    }
  ],
  "total": 2841,
  "hasMore": true
}
```

### Property fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| id | string | Unique listing identifier (base64url, ~22 chars) |
| type | string | condo, house, townhouse, commercial, land, other |
| status | string | "rent" (monthly) or "sale" (purchase) |
| price | number | Price in THB. Rent = per month. Sale = total. |
| priceCurrency | string | Currency code, always "THB" |
| pricePerSqm | number or null | Price per square meter |
| area | number or null | Floor area in square meters |
| bedrooms | number or null | Number of bedrooms |
| bathrooms | number or null | Number of bathrooms |
| address | string | Street address or area description |
| loc | array or null | [longitude, latitude] in GeoJSON order. null if missing. |
| images | string[] | Array of full CDN image URLs (https://images.o-waw.com/...) |
| projectName | string or null | Name of the condominium building or development |
| projectId | string or null | ID of the associated project (for cross-referencing) |
| description | string or null | Full property description in English |
| createdAt | number | Listing creation timestamp (ms since Unix epoch) |

## GET /llm/properties/{id}

Full property detail by ID. Returns all fields from the list response plus:

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| floorNumber | number or null | Which floor the unit is on |
| petFriendly | boolean or null | Whether pets are allowed |
| marketPrice | number or null | Estimated market value in THB |
| updatedAt | number | Last update timestamp (ms since epoch) |

Returns 404 if the property doesn't exist or is not active.

## GET /llm/projects

Search real estate projects (condominiums, housing developments, commercial buildings).

### Parameters (all optional)

| Parameter | Type | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|-------------|---------|
| type | string or string[] (repeat) | Project type: condo, house, townhouse, commercial, land, other | type=condo |
| search | string | Full-text search across name and description | search=sukhumvit |
| lat | number | Latitude for geographic search | lat=13.7242 |
| lng | number | Longitude for geographic search | lng=100.5650 |
| radius | number | Search radius in km (max 100) | radius=5 |
| minYearBuilt | integer | Filter projects built after this year | minYearBuilt=2020 |
| maxYearBuilt | integer | Filter projects built before this year | maxYearBuilt=2024 |
| limit | integer | Max results (1-100, default 20) | limit=20 |
| skip | integer | Pagination offset | skip=20 |

### Response

```json
{
  "projects": [
    {
      "id": "eNaAq7762Cd9mDwvFKZL6Q",
      "name": "15 Sukhumvit Residences",
      "type": "condo",
      "loc": [100.5581, 13.7420],
      "address": "50 Sukhumvit 15, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana",
      "district": "Watthana",
      "city": "",
      "province": "Krung Thep Maha Nakhon",
      "images": ["https://images.o-waw.com/kscg8nYLSPoApA"],
      "developer": "",
      "yearBuilt": 2013,
      "totalUnits": null,
      "totalFloors": null,
      "description": "25-story high-rise condominium...",
      "createdAt": 1779402492750
    }
  ],
  "total": 1323,
  "hasMore": true
}
```

### Project fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| id | string | Unique project identifier |
| name | string | Project/condominium name |
| type | string | condo, house, townhouse, commercial, land, other |
| loc | array or null | [longitude, latitude] |
| address | string or null | Street address |
| district | string or null | Bangkok district (e.g. "Watthana", "Khlong Toei") |
| city | string or null | City name |
| province | string or null | Province ("Krung Thep Maha Nakhon" = Bangkok) |
| images | string[] | Array of full CDN image URLs |
| developer | string or null | Developer company name |
| yearBuilt | number or null | Year the project was completed |
| totalUnits | number or null | Total number of residential units |
| totalFloors | number or null | Number of floors |
| description | string or null | Project description |

## GET /llm/projects/{id}

Full project detail by ID. Returns all fields from the list response plus:

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| activeListingCount | number | Number of property listings currently available in this project |

Returns 404 if the project doesn't exist.

## GET /llms.txt

Concise plaintext API guide (this file is the expanded version).

## GET /health

Health check. Returns: { "status": "ok", "uptime": 432000 }

# Pagination

All list endpoints support cursor-free offset pagination:
- `limit`: items per page (1-100, default 20)
- `skip`: offset from start (default 0)
- Response includes `total` (total matching count) and `hasMore` (boolean)

To get all results, increment skip by limit until hasMore is false.

# Geographic Search

Use lat + lng + radius to find properties or projects within a distance of a point. Coordinates use GeoJSON order: [longitude, latitude]. Radius is in kilometers, maximum 100km.

Example: Find condos within 2km of Thonglor BTS station:
```
GET /llm/properties?status=rent&type=condo&lat=13.7224&lng=100.5819&radius=2&limit=20
```

# Property Types

| Type | Description | Typical price range (rent) |
|------|-------------|---------------------------|
| condo | Condominium unit (most common) | 8,000 - 200,000 THB/mo |
| house | Detached or semi-detached house | 30,000 - 500,000 THB/mo |
| townhouse | Row house / townhome | 15,000 - 80,000 THB/mo |
| commercial | Commercial space, shop, office | 20,000 - 1,000,000 THB/mo |
| land | Vacant land plot | Varies by size and zone |
| other | Miscellaneous | Varies |

# Listing Status

| Status | Meaning | Price interpretation |
|--------|---------|---------------------|
| rent | Available for rent | Monthly rental price in THB |
| sale | Available for purchase | Total purchase price in THB |

# Currency and Price Context

All prices are in Thai Baht (THB). As of 2025:
- 1 USD ≈ 33-35 THB
- 1 EUR ≈ 36-38 THB
- 1 GBP ≈ 42-44 THB
- 1 CNY ≈ 4.5-5 THB
- 1 JPY ≈ 0.22 THB

Typical Bangkok condo rent: 15,000 THB/mo ≈ $430 USD/mo
Typical Bangkok condo sale: 4,000,000 THB ≈ $115,000 USD

# Images

All image URLs are served from CDN: https://images.o-waw.com/{key}
- Keys are compact base64url strings (13-14 characters)
- Full URLs are returned directly — no URL construction needed
- Properties typically have 3-8 photos
- Projects may have 0-10+ photos
- First image in the array is typically the best/primary photo

# Coordinates

All coordinate fields (`loc`) use GeoJSON order: [longitude, latitude]
- Longitude range for Bangkok: ~100.45 to 100.70
- Latitude range for Bangkok: ~13.60 to 13.90
- Bangkok approximate center: [100.5018, 13.7563]

# Error Responses

All errors return JSON: { "success": false, "error": string, "message": string }

| HTTP Code | Meaning |
|-----------|---------|
| 200 | Success |
| 400 | Invalid query parameters |
| 404 | Resource not found |
| 500 | Internal server error |

# Rate Limits

No hard rate limits. Be reasonable — use pagination (limit/skip) instead of requesting all data in one call. Recommended: limit=100 with sequential skip.

# Examples

## Find a cheap condo near Asok BTS

```
GET /llm/properties?status=rent&type=condo&lat=13.7242&lng=100.5650&radius=1&maxPrice=20000&limit=10
```

## 3-bedroom house for sale under 10 million THB

```
GET /llm/properties?status=sale&type=house&maxPrice=10000000&minBedrooms=3&limit=10
```

## All condos in a specific building

```
GET /llm/properties?projectId=HeYdXW8KK2GW42i8_ILzrg&limit=50
```

## New condominium projects (built after 2022)

```
GET /llm/projects?type=condo&minYearBuilt=2022&limit=20
```

## Full-text search: pet-friendly Sukhumvit condos

```
GET /llm/properties?status=rent&type=condo&search=sukhumvit+pet&limit=10
```

# Agent Discovery Standards

O-WAW supports multiple standards for automated agent discovery:

| Standard | URL | Specification |
|----------|-----|---------------|
| llms.txt | https://api.o-waw.com/llms.txt | https://llmstxt.org |
| llms-full.txt | https://api.o-waw.com/llms-full.txt | Extended version (this document) |
| API Catalog | https://api.o-waw.com/.well-known/api-catalog | RFC 9727 |
| MCP Server Card | https://api.o-waw.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json | SEP-1649 |
| Agent Skills Index | https://api.o-waw.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json | Agent Skills v0.2.0 |
| OpenAPI Spec | https://api.o-waw.com/api/docs/json | OpenAPI 3.0 |
| Interactive Docs | https://api.o-waw.com/api/docs | Swagger UI |
| Health Check | https://api.o-waw.com/health | Service status |
| robots.txt | https://o-waw.com/robots.txt | Explicit AI crawler consent |

All responses from api.o-waw.com include RFC 8288 Link headers pointing to these resources.

| Language | Package | Install |

| Python | No SDK — use requests | See examples at https://github.com/exreve/o-waw-agent-tools |
